dzh: 1937年，民国二十六年、昭和十二年。七月七日卢沟桥枪响，日本全面侵华。国民政府训政未久，晋绥、冀察、山东、四川、云南、广西、西北马家各据一方；陕甘宁边区新与国民政府停战，共御外侮。日本以满洲国、蒙古军政府、冀东为傀儡，吞并朝鲜，以台湾为殖民地，大韩民国临时政府寄居中国。从淞沪、南京、武汉一路打到太平洋战争、苏联出兵、日本投降，再到国共内战。欧洲西班牙内战正酣，德国将吞并奥地利、捷克，进攻波兰与苏联。
den: AD 1937, the twenty-sixth year of the Republic and the twelfth of Showa. Shots at the Marco Polo Bridge on 7 July open Japan's all-out war on China. The Nationalists rule under party tutelage while Shanxi, Hebei-Chahar, Shandong, Sichuan, Yunnan, Guangxi and the Ma clan hold their own; the Communist border region has just made peace with Nanjing to face the invader together. Japan keeps Manchukuo, Prince De's Mongols and East Hebei as puppets, has annexed Korea, holds Taiwan as a colony, and the Korean Provisional Government lives in exile in China. From Shanghai, Nanjing and Wuhan to the Pacific War, the Soviet invasion of Manchuria, Japan's surrender and the Chinese Civil War. In Europe the Spanish Civil War rages and Germany prepares to swallow Austria and Czechoslovakia and to strike Poland and Russia.
